note: vespera_macro: request views no longer hang the build when two documented types share a Rust ident and classify differently (flattened-kind lookup is keyed by the scoped key or the unique ident, and the fixpoint only grows). A module-qualified flattened type resolves to its own module's declaration. Repeated garde format rules are all documented (the first in format, the rest as allOf members). An un-imported qualifier under a local glob stays external unless a glob target declares that module. The same alias tokens in two modules are ambiguous, not one definition.
